1
Zakhmi Maa Zehra Sonu Monu Lyrics
Haye Zainab Ki Zakhmi Maa Zahra.
Hai Madine Mein Be Amaan Zahra.
Roz Soraj Nikal Ke Kehta Hai.
Qabar Dhondon Teri Kahan Zahra.
Oss Taraf Jalta Dar Idhar Dewar.
Our Dono Ke Darmiyaan Zahra.
Tum Ne Haider Se Bhi Chupaye Rakha.
Taziyane Ka Woh Nishaan Zahra.
Toot Kar Khak Par Girein Kaisay.
Tere Kano Ki Baliyaan Zahra.
Ajar Bas Yeh Mila Risalat Ka.
Le Gayi Tooti Pasliyaan Zahra.
Zakhmi Ho Kar Bhi Apne Maula Ki.
Tu Ne Khulwa Di Rasiyaan Zahra.
